description: Fetch one catalog product in the selected workspace by product id or SKU — returned in any status (draft, active, or archived; check the status field) — with every catalog field: prices, cost, stock and trackInventory, availability, variant fields, all attributes (characteristics) and translations, identifiers, weight and dimensions, images, videos, bundle components and related products; plus its model, warehouse and supplier by name, storageBin (the place in that warehouse where it lies — code and description, null when it has none; a label, not a quantity), supplierOffers (what the supplier last said: quantity, restock date, purchase price, state), locations (the units in each warehouse — quantity, reserved by open orders, available, status — adding up to stock; null when the workspace keeps one count per product), fulfillment (what Amazon FBA holds — ready to ship, inbound, reserved, unfulfillable, when last read — never part of stock; null when off), every sales channel with its listing and moderation state, the collections it is in and its model's review summary; channelTexts (the title and bullet points written for a channel such as Amazon, per language), safetyDocuments (safety PDFs a marketplace receives) and gpsr (the manufacturer and EU responsible person with their emails, each from the brand, else the supplier). A bundle's stock and cost are derived from its components. Provide exactly one known identifier; use search_products first when unsure (search covers active products only).

id.description: The product id returned by search_products.

sku.description: The product SKU returned by search_products.

name: get_product
title: Get product
